channel.title: The Drill Down: San Francisco 49ers
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 11: Vikings at 49ers
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 8:20 PM ET | Line: SF -3 · O/U 46.5 | Model SF 78% vs. market 61% | Minnesota's pass rush, which generates pressure on 28% of dropbacks and ranks first in the league, meets a San Francisco line rated 8th in protection, and whichever side wins that collision decides whether Brock Purdy gets clean throws. Justin Jefferson soaks up 29% of Minnesota's targets, and he runs straight into a San Francisco pass defense that ranks 6th. Our model has San Francisco at 78% against the market's 61%, and the rushing matchup drives most of that gap.

item.title: Week 10: 49ers at Cowboys
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: SF -4.5 · O/U 55.5 | Model DAL 41% vs. market 36% | Dallas has to win in the red zone, where its defense allows touchdowns on 63% of trips, ranking 23rd, against a 49ers offense that cashes in at a league-best rate. CeeDee Lamb draws 35% of Dallas' targets and must beat a San Francisco pass defense ranked 6th. Our model has San Francisco at 59%, a shade under the market's 64%, driven mainly by the passing matchup.
